tips.text: Pledge Suda first, since it also fills Hexis at half rate, then switch your pledge to Steel Meridian.
Level Corvas as your Necramech's archgun in Orb Vallis, Cambion Drift, Entrati Labs or a Void survival fissure; the mech levels too and needs no Gravimag.
Level it in Archwing on Salacia, Neptune; a Steel Path run or an affinity booster speeds it up.
Install an Orokin Catalyst and a Gravimag to deploy it in any ground mission, where it levels about like a normal gun.
Stop each syndicate at Rank 2; Rank 3 buys nothing Corvas needs.
Raise Meridian, Suda and Hexis together; none of the three drags another one down.
The farm is only the standing; players call Corvas the most fun archgun and do not regret it.
Expect two daily caps of Meridian and two to three of Suda; levelling the gun draws more complaints than getting it.
